Ho ho hello Sitters! Are you feeling festive? ⛄🍪

The Baby in Yellow's Christmas update is OUT NOW! And we've got a selection of goodies for you to enjoy this holiday season:

[b]A Curious Christmas[/b]
The heavily-anticipated 'Curious Christmas' chapter is making a return! Help The Baby carry out various Christmas tasks, like building a snowman, [strike]running from mysterious dark forces[/strike], decorating the tree, and preparing Christmas dinner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/32bf0c633701a1c1ca8e4533e75d034e41444525.gif[/img]

[b]Christmas Decorations[/b]
It wouldn't be Christmas without decking the halls! Decorations are now visible in every chapter ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/0b912705bb85ca21598cbcc365b497c6806ec21b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/4a3cc0a15df13861aaa8cacbbe07e015e7656d72.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/8b91a0e78b6b0c3752607a486a184fa5ef21e161.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Alongside the Christmas update, we have also fixed the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Player is no longer softlocked if they enter the secret passage in Pickman's Apartment when the King's Lullaby is playing.
[*] Player is no longer softlocked if they hug the walls during navigation of the maze corridor of The Exit.
[*] Removed invisible geometry in the 'Cot void' section of 'The Exit'.
[*] Fixed various map geometry bounds and culling issues.
[*] Fixed permanent hang which could occur when changing language and unpausing the game quickly.
[*] Subtitles for voice audio now show if the game is muted.
[*] Toys no longer sink through floor when stacked.
[*] Baby no longer appears floating in mid-air when playing Hide and Seek in Nights 1-3.
[*] TV in Night 1 no longer shows a checkerboard pattern.
[*] Baby's bottle no longer tunnels through the ceiling in 'The Exit'.
[*] Dying to the TV head baby in 'The Exit' no longer causes baby to appear floating in mid air when player respawns
[*] Fixed up audio synchronization with banging door in 'The Exit'.
[*] Objective text display is now limited to the last 3 objectives in 'The Exit' (as in the rest of the game).
[*] If the baby's outfit is changed, this is now correctly updated in the final objective of 'The Exit'.
[*] Baby can no longer recover from being stunned if he is being loaded into the cannon in The Laboratory garden.
[*] Loading into the checkpoint in the 'Worlds Collide' chapter no longer results in player holding an invisible baby.
[*] Whoopee cushion now reinflates correctly.
[*] Audio stinger no longer plays twice if player is frozen by the baby's snowballs in A Curious Christmas.
[/list]

As always, we'd like to thank you for your ongoing support, we hope you enjoy the update and wish you a very happy holidays! 💛

notes.title: 🌒 Dark Whispers Out Now! 🌘
notes.content:
[b]The time has come and the Dark Whispers update is OUT NOW! 🎉[/b]

Get ready for a riveting ride, because we've got a lot of exciting things in store for you! 👇
[h3]
Graphical Improvements[/h3]
As you may have already noticed in a few of our social posts, the graphics quality of the game has improved massively! Thanks to the enhanced capabilities of Unreal Engine 5, we've been able to polish the game's visuals to a much higher quality than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/22b972fb87933aead84fdef7c1c2e2805cb2ee28.png[/img]

The graphical changes don't just apply to the environment, we've also given The Baby's monster form a 'facelift' (so to speak). We hope you weren't planning on sleeping any time soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/5acf2eeb41861e6fcadb04f090ea1bc3896fe69a.png[/img]

[h3]Visual Reworks[/h3]
Alice Pickman has had the eldrich beings of construction pay her a visit, and the results are stunning!

We wanted to provide more of a glimpse into Alice's character, and her downfall, in this upgraded version of her apartment. Here's a full tour of her new space! 

[previewyoutube=Ekd86EV_fUg;full][/previewyoutube]
The power room has also undergone some maintenence (what with The Baby constantly messing with the fuses!)

[previewyoutube=5B2hxJ7lmag;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Reworked Levels[/h3]
We have completely reworked the levels 'Pickman's Madness' and 'The Exit', keeping it's core elements but adding some new features to make it truly feel like you're fighting to escape. The new and improved levels are guaranteed to keep your mind sharp and your hairs raised...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/f18c95da2d09b6f628392a1a3ed0c7fec75f05d7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/dd2fa2786d36c60c67dac8d6216574f66954afe8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/ccd137bf8408be69c0c8daffef2252f994caf1a8.gif[/img]

[h3]More lore[/h3]
There's also plenty more lore for all of you seekers out there that wish to delve a little deeper, such as new snippets from the mother's phone calls during nights 1-3!

[previewyoutube=xD6ara2O5k8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Thank you! [/h3]
As always, we're grateful to our community for their support, excitement, AND incredible fanmade content! We'd like to give a special shoutout the winners of our most recent 'Triad of Mystery' Discord art competition, [i]supergirlytreiner[/i], [i]sodium-hypobr0mite[/i] and [i]rusty_spoom[/i]. Honourable mentions too from [i]springtrap16[/i], [i]_warship[/i] and [i]cl0udvv_st4r.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/c2c53eba2360fd93269b8496a51b05b3981bd9f3.png[/img]

You never cease to amaze us with your creativity, and we're always over the moon to see what our fans create! 💛

We hope you enjoy Dark Whispers and look forward to bringing you more thrilling content soon! 💛

notes.title: Unreal Engine 4 & Christmas Branches
notes.content:
As most of you are aware, The Baby in Yellow has now been ported to Unreal Engine 5, this opens the door to more exciting possibilities for the game's future. 

However, if you wish to play the older, Unreal Engine 4 build of the game, either for modding or for a little touch of nostalgia, you can now do so by using our newest UE4 branch! The same applies to our 'Curious Christmas' update branch, for those who want to get in the festive mood all year round.

[h3]You can switch to one of the older versions of the game by:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Right-clicking on The Baby in Yellow in your Steam Library
[*] Left Click Properties
[*] Left Click Betas
[*] In the Beta Participation drop down select the branch you want to access ([b]ue4_2024[/b] or [b]christmas_2023[/b] )
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b]
[i][list]
[*] These branches will not be updated. To see any new content, please swap back to “none” in the Beta Participation drop down. This will switch back to the latest version of the game.
[*] To avoid save game compatibility issues in the future, older branches will use their own save file. Which can be typically found in [code]C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\Local\BabyInYellow\Saved\SaveGames[/code]
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Update Notes 14th July
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

We hope you have been enjoying the summer holidays. 

Our first patch includes a handful of bug fixes and some small quality of life features.

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can no longer carry the core throughout the Final Chase
[*] Newt can no longer be held during the Final Cutscene
[*] Newt recovers to a safe location once Players complete the Library Puzzle
[*] Non-critical objects are properly cleaned up if thrown off the edge of the Garden
[*] Changed Console Screen Minigame start prompt text from "Tap" to "Click" for PC
[*] Continuity issues with Checkpoint Saves
[*] Regression issues with Pre-Black Cat Content
[*] Localization issues with the "World Door" Signage
[/list]

[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Players can now restore the Baby's Default Outfit after equipping the Black Cat Outfit
[*]  The Gyrosphere walkway now extends upon Players entering the balcony holding the core
[*]  Newt's “No” head shake reaction when offered an unwanted item is now rate limited
[/list]

Thank you all for playing, we have many more updates - big and small - on the way so be sure to check back.

See you soon, 

[i]Team Terrible[/i]

notes.title: The Baby in Yellow Black Cat OUT NOW
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that "The Baby in Yellow" is now available on Steam Early Access!

But that's not all. Alongside our Steam launch, we're unveiling the largest and most exciting update yet — The Black Cat! This fresh chapter in the ongoing story of The Baby in Yellow promises to be even more exciting than anything you've experienced so far.

We've introduced new characters, puzzles and levels. Follow the Black Cat, discover more about the story of The Baby and play around with some alchemy!

Don't keep the baby (or the cat) waiting. Your next babysitting shift starts now!


Thank you for your continued support and love for The Baby in Yellow. Your excitement and feedback drive us to make our game better and spookier with each update.

-Team Terrible
